name: Active Employees Base
code:
-- Retrieve active employees based on the current date
-- Joining people and names tables using effective dates
SELECT
  papf.person_number,
  ppnf.full_name
FROM
  per_all_people_f papf
  INNER JOIN per_person_names_f ppnf ON papf.person_id = ppnf.person_id
WHERE
  -- Ensure we only pull records active as of today
  TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN papf.effective_start_date AND papf.effective_end_date
  -- Filter for the global name type to avoid duplicates
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN ppnf.effective_start_date AND ppnf.effective_end_date

name: Today's Date & Date Math
code:
-- Demonstrate common date truncations and modifications
SELECT 
  -- Get today's date with the time truncated to midnight
  TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS current_date,
  -- Get the first day of the current month
  TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AS first_day_of_month,
  -- Get the first day of the current year
  TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AS first_day_of_year,
  -- Subtract exactly 12 months from today
  ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -12) AS one_year_ago
FROM DUAL

name: String Manipulation (SUBSTR & INSTR)
code:
-- Extract specific parts of strings commonly used in reporting
SELECT
  person_number,
  -- Take only the first 5 characters of the person number
  SUBSTR(person_number, 1, 5) AS first_5_chars,
  email_address,
  -- Extract the domain from an email address dynamically using INSTR to find the '@' symbol
  SUBSTR(email_address, INSTR(email_address, '@') + 1) AS email_domain
FROM
  per_email_addresses
WHERE 
  email_type = 'W1' -- W1 usually denotes Work Email

name: Regular Expressions (Regex)
code:
-- Using regex to clean or validate data fields
SELECT
  phone_number,
  -- Strip out all non-numeric characters (like dashes, spaces, or parentheses) from a phone number
  REGEXP_REPLACE(phone_number, '[^0-9]', '') AS numbers_only,
  email_address,
  -- Validate email format (returns 1 if valid, 0 if invalid)
  REGEXP_INSTR(email_address, '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,4}$') AS is_valid_email
FROM
  per_phones

name: CTE (WITH Clause) for Latest Assignment
code:
-- Use a Common Table Expression (CTE) to simplify complex logic
-- Here we find the most recent assignment for each person
WITH LatestAssignment AS (
  SELECT
    person_id,
    assignment_id,
    assignment_name,
    -- Rank assignments by effective start date descending per person
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id ORDER BY effective_start_date DESC) as rn
  FROM
    per_all_assignments_m
  WHERE
    assignment_type IN ('E', 'C') -- Filter for Employees (E) or Contingent Workers (C)
)
-- Select only the row where rn = 1 (the most recent assignment)
SELECT
  person_id,
  assignment_name
FROM
  LatestAssignment
WHERE
  rn = 1

name: CASE Statement & Null Handling (NVL)
code:
-- Handle null values and translate codes into readable text
SELECT
  person_id,
  -- Replace null values with a default string using NVL
  NVL(proposed_worker_type, 'Unknown') AS worker_type,
  -- Translate system status codes into user-friendly values
  CASE assignment_status_type
    WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 'Currently Employed'
    WHEN 'SUSPENDED' THEN 'On Leave'
    WHEN 'INACTIVE' THEN 'Terminated'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS readable_status
FROM
  per_all_assignments_m
WHERE
  -- Ensure we are looking at the current slice of the assignment
  TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date

name: List Aggregation (LISTAGG)
code:
-- Combine multiple rows into a single comma-separated string
SELECT
  person_id,
  -- Group all roles a user has into one concatenated string
  LISTAGG(role_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY role_name) AS user_roles
FROM
  per_user_roles
GROUP BY
  person_id

name: Get Current Line Manager
code:
-- Fetch the active Line Manager for an assignment
SELECT
  pasf.person_id AS employee_person_id,
  pasf.manager_id,
  ppnf.full_name AS manager_name
FROM
  per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf
  INNER JOIN per_person_names_f ppnf ON pasf.manager_id = ppnf.person_id
WHERE
  pasf.manager_type = 'LINE_MANAGER'
  AND ppnf.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  -- Ensure supervisor record is active today
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN pasf.effective_start_date AND pasf.effective_end_date
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN ppnf.effective_start_date AND ppnf.effective_end_date

name: Fetch Department Name
code:

  hou_tl.name AS department_name
FROM

  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date

name: Fetch Job Name
code:

  paam.person_id,

name: Fetch Current Base Salary
code:

SELECT
  cs.assignment_id,
  cs.salary_amount,
  cs.currency_code,
  cs.annual_salary

name: National Identifier (SSN / NI)
code:

name: Format Dates to Strings (TO_CHAR)
code:
-- Convert dates to specific readable string formats
SELECT
  -- Format as YYYY-MM-DD (2026-05-26)
  TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS iso_date,
  -- Format as Month DD, YYYY (May 26, 2026)
  TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'Month DD, YYYY') AS spelled_out_date,
  -- Extract just the Year
  TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AS current_year
FROM DUAL

name: Advanced Date Math (LAST_DAY, MONTHS_BETWEEN)
code:
-- Useful functions for calculating durations and boundaries
SELECT
  -- Get the last day of the current month
  LAST_DAY(SYSDATE) AS end_of_month,
  -- Find the next upcoming Friday
  NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'FRIDAY') AS next_friday,
  -- Calculate age in years (Months between today and DOB, divided by 12)
  FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), DATE '1990-01-01') / 12) AS calculated_age
FROM DUAL

name: FND Lookups (Translation Values)
code:
-- Fetch the meaning of a system lookup code
SELECT
  lookup_code,
  meaning,
  description
FROM
  fnd_lookup_values
WHERE
  lookup_type = 'MARITAL_STATUS' -- Replace with your desired lookup type
  AND language = 'US'
  AND enabled_flag = 'Y'
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN start_date_active AND NVL(end_date_active, TO_DATE('4712-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))

name: String Padding (LPAD / RPAD)
code:
-- Pad strings with characters (useful for bank files or fixed-width exports)
SELECT
  person_number,
  -- Pad person number with leading zeros to make it exactly 10 characters long
  LPAD(person_number, 10, '0') AS padded_person_num,
  -- Pad a name with trailing spaces up to 50 characters
  RPAD(last_name, 50, ' ') AS fixed_width_name
FROM
  per_all_people_f
WHERE
  TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date

name: Capitalization & Case (UPPER, INITCAP)
code:
-- Standardize string casing for reporting
SELECT
  -- Force all letters to uppercase
  UPPER(email_address) AS upper_email,
  -- Force all letters to lowercase
  LOWER(email_address) AS lower_email,
  -- Capitalize the first letter of each word
  INITCAP(first_name || ' ' || last_name) AS title_case_name
FROM
  per_person_names_f
WHERE
  name_type = 'GLOBAL'

name: COALESCE (Multiple Fallbacks)
code:
-- COALESCE returns the first non-null value in a list
SELECT
  person_id,
  -- If known_as is null, use first_name. If first_name is null, use 'Unknown'
  COALESCE(known_as, first_name, 'Unknown') AS preferred_first_name
FROM
  per_person_names_f
WHERE
  name_type = 'GLOBAL'
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date

name: Parse Comma-Separated Strings (REGEXP_SUBSTR)
code:
-- Extract specific items from a delimited string
SELECT
  'Apple,Banana,Orange' AS fruit_list,
  -- Extract the 2nd item from the comma-separated list (Returns Banana)
  REGEXP_SUBSTR('Apple,Banana,Orange', '[^,]+', 1, 2) AS second_item
FROM DUAL

name: Fetch Logged-in User Context
code:
-- Get information about the user currently running the BI Publisher report
SELECT
  -- Returns the username of the logged-in user
  FND_GLOBAL.user_name AS current_user,
  -- Returns the internal user_id
  FND_GLOBAL.user_id AS current_user_id

name: Identify Latest Record (Max Effective Date)
code:
-- Filter a table to only show the absolute latest historical slice (even in the future)
SELECT
  person_id,
  person_number,
  effective_start_date
FROM
  per_all_people_f p1
WHERE
  effective_end_date = (
    SELECT MAX(effective_end_date)
    FROM per_all_people_f p2
    WHERE p1.person_id = p2.person_id
  )

name: Count and Group Aggregation
code:
-- Count how many active employees belong to each department
SELECT
  hou_tl.name AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT paam.person_id) AS active_headcount
FROM
  per_all_assignments_m paam
  INNER JOIN hr_organization_units_f_tl hou_tl ON paam.organization_id = hou_tl.organization_id
WHERE
  paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
  AND hou_tl.language = 'US'
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
GROUP BY
  hou_tl.name
ORDER BY
  active_headcount DESC

name: Latest Record using ROW_NUMBER()
code:
-- Get the absolute latest person record using a window function instead of a self-join to MAX()
SELECT
  person_id,
  person_number,
  effective_start_date,
  effective_end_date
FROM (
  SELECT
    person_id,
    person_number,
    effective_start_date,
    effective_end_date,
    -- Assign a row number of 1 to the most recent effective start date per person
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id ORDER BY effective_start_date DESC) as rn
  FROM
    per_all_people_f
)
WHERE
  rn = 1

name: Compare Previous Row using LAG()
code:
-- Compare current salary to previous salary without a self-join
SELECT
  assignment_id,
  date_from,
  salary_amount AS current_salary,
  -- Fetch the salary_amount from the chronologically previous row
  LAG(salary_amount, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY assignment_id ORDER BY date_from ASC) AS previous_salary
FROM
  cmp_salary

name: Find Next Row Value using LEAD()
code:
-- Look ahead to the next assignment status
SELECT
  assignment_id,
  effective_start_date,
  assignment_status_type AS current_status,
  -- Fetch the status of the NEXT chronological row
  LEAD(assignment_status_type, 1, 'END') OVER (PARTITION BY assignment_id ORDER BY effective_start_date ASC) AS next_status
FROM
  per_all_assignments_m

name: Rank Top Earners using DENSE_RANK()
code:
-- Rank employees by salary amount within their business unit
SELECT
  assignment_id,
  salary_amount,
  -- Ranks salaries, giving ties the same rank and not skipping subsequent numbers
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary_amount DESC) as salary_rank
FROM
  cmp_salary
WHERE
  TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN date_from AND date_to

name: Fetch Primary Mailing Address
code:
-- Retrieve the primary home address for an employee
SELECT
  pa.person_id,
  addr.address_line_1,
  addr.address_line_2,
  addr.town_or_city,
  addr.postal_code,
  addr.country
FROM
  per_person_addresses_v pa
  INNER JOIN per_addresses_f addr ON pa.address_id = addr.address_id
WHERE
  pa.primary_flag = 'Y'
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN pa.effective_start_date AND pa.effective_end_date
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN addr.effective_start_date AND addr.effective_end_date

code:

  TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date

name: Original Hire Date (Enterprise)
code:
-- Get the enterprise-level original hire date for a worker
SELECT
  person_id,
  date_start AS enterprise_hire_date
FROM
  per_periods_of_service
WHERE
  -- Get the earliest period of service
  period_of_service_id = (
    SELECT MIN(period_of_service_id) 
    FROM per_periods_of_service p2 
    WHERE p2.person_id = per_periods_of_service.person_id
  )

name: Termination Date & Reason
code:
-- Get the termination date and reason for inactive employees
SELECT
  person_id,
  actual_termination_date,
  action_code AS termination_reason
FROM
  per_periods_of_service
WHERE
  actual_termination_date IS NOT NULL
  AND actual_termination_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)

name: Fetch Oracle User Account
code:

  pu.person_id,
  pu.username,
  pu.active_flag AS account_active,
  pu.creation_date
FROM
  per_users pu
WHERE
  pu.person_id IS NOT NULL

name: Masking Sensitive Data (SSN)
code:
-- Mask all but the last 4 digits of a string (like an SSN or Bank Account)
SELECT
  national_identifier_number AS original_ssn,
  -- Use LPAD and SUBSTR to mask the first 5 characters
  LPAD(SUBSTR(national_identifier_number, -4), LENGTH(national_identifier_number), '*') AS masked_ssn
FROM
  per_national_identifiers

name: GREATEST and LEAST Functions
code:
-- Find the highest or lowest value among a list of columns
SELECT
  person_id,
  -- Returns the latest of three dates
  GREATEST(creation_date, last_update_date, effective_start_date) AS most_recent_action,
  -- Returns the earliest of three dates
  LEAST(creation_date, last_update_date, effective_start_date) AS earliest_action
FROM
  per_all_people_f
WHERE 
  TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date

name: String Replacement (REPLACE)
code:
-- Replace all occurrences of a specific substring
SELECT
  email_address,
  -- Replace an old domain name with a new one
  REPLACE(email_address, '@oldcompany.com', '@newcompany.com') AS updated_email
FROM
  per_email_addresses

name: Find Nth Occurrence (INSTR)
code:
-- Find the position of the 2nd occurrence of a character
SELECT
  full_name,
  -- Find the position of the second space in a name
  INSTR(full_name, ' ', 1, 2) as position_of_second_space
FROM
  per_person_names_f
WHERE name_type = 'GLOBAL'

name: Extract Year/Month from Date
code:
-- Extract specific date parts using the EXTRACT function
SELECT
  SYSDATE,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) AS current_year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE) AS current_month,
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM SYSDATE) AS current_day
FROM DUAL

name: Avoid Divide by Zero (NULLIF)
code:
-- Safely divide numbers by turning a zero denominator into NULL
SELECT
  total_sales,
  target_sales,
  -- If target_sales is 0, NULLIF makes it NULL, preventing a crash. Result of division by NULL is NULL.
  (total_sales / NULLIF(target_sales, 0)) * 100 AS completion_percentage
FROM
  some_custom_sales_table

name: Oracle DECODE (Switch Statement)
code:
-- Old-school Oracle alternative to simple CASE statements
SELECT
  assignment_status_type,
  -- DECODE(column, search1, result1, search2, result2, default)
  DECODE(assignment_status_type, 'ACTIVE', 'Employed', 'INACTIVE', 'Terminated', 'Unknown') AS decoded_status
FROM
  per_all_assignments_m

name: Cast / Convert Data Types
code:
-- Convert strings to numbers or dates
SELECT
  -- Convert a string to a numeric value
  CAST('12345' AS NUMBER) AS num_val,
  -- Convert a string to a date using TO_DATE
  TO_DATE('2026-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS parsed_date
FROM DUAL

name: Trim Whitespace (TRIM, LTRIM, RTRIM)
code:
-- Clean up extra spaces around strings
SELECT
  '   John Doe   ' AS raw_string,
  TRIM('   John Doe   ') AS fully_trimmed,
  LTRIM('   John Doe   ') AS left_trimmed,
  RTRIM('   John Doe   ') AS right_trimmed
FROM DUAL

name: Count String Characters (LENGTH)
code:

  first_name,
  LENGTH(first_name) AS name_length
FROM
  per_person_names_f
WHERE
  LENGTH(first_name) > 15 -- Find exceptionally long names

name: Count Specific Characters (REGEXP_COUNT)
code:

SELECT
  full_name,
  -- Count how many spaces are in the full name
  REGEXP_COUNT(full_name, ' ') AS space_count
FROM
  per_person_names_f

name: Generate Unique ID (SYS_GUID)
code:
-- Generate a globally unique 32-character hexadecimal identifier
SELECT
  SYS_GUID() AS unique_identifier
FROM DUAL

name: Basic PIVOT Example
code:
-- Rotate rows into columns (e.g., counting genders)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT person_id, sex FROM per_all_people_f
)
PIVOT (
  COUNT(person_id)
  FOR sex IN ('M' AS male_count, 'F' AS female_count)
)

name: Basic UNPIVOT Example
code:
-- Rotate columns into rows
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT person_id, attribute1, attribute2 FROM per_all_people_f
)
UNPIVOT (
  attribute_value FOR attribute_name IN (attribute1, attribute2)
)

name: Manager Hierarchy (CONNECT BY)
code:
-- Build a hierarchical tree of managers and employees
SELECT
  pasf.person_id,
  pasf.manager_id,
  LEVEL AS hierarchy_level
FROM
  per_assignment_supervisors_f pasf
WHERE
  TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN pasf.effective_start_date AND pasf.effective_end_date
-- Start with the CEO (someone with no manager)
START WITH pasf.manager_id IS NULL
-- Walk down the tree
CONNECT BY PRIOR pasf.person_id = pasf.manager_id

name: Combine Huge Strings (XMLAGG)
code:
-- Use XMLAGG instead of LISTAGG to bypass the 4000 character limit
SELECT
  department_id,
  -- Convert strings to XML elements, aggregate them, extract text, and trim the leading comma
  LTRIM(EXTRACT(XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(E, ',' || person_number) ORDER BY person_number).EXTRACT('//text()'), '/').GETSTRINGVAL(), ',') AS all_employees
FROM
  per_all_assignments_m
GROUP BY department_id

name: Round Dates (ROUND)
code:
-- Round a date to the nearest month or year (different from TRUNC)
SELECT
  SYSDATE,
  -- Rounds up to next month if past the 15th
  ROUND(SYSDATE, 'MM') AS rounded_month,
  -- Rounds up to next year if past June 30th
  ROUND(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AS rounded_year
FROM DUAL

name: Truncate to Quarter (TRUNC Q)
code:
-- Get the first day of the current quarter
SELECT
  TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q') AS first_day_of_quarter
FROM DUAL

name: Subquery in SELECT (Scalar Subquery)
code:
-- Fetch a single value from another table directly in the SELECT clause
SELECT
  paam.person_id,
  paam.assignment_id,
  (
    SELECT email_address 
    FROM per_email_addresses e 
    WHERE e.person_id = paam.person_id AND e.email_type = 'W1' 
    AND ROWNUM = 1
  ) AS work_email
FROM
  per_all_assignments_m paam

name: Wildcards and Escaping (LIKE)
code:
-- Search for strings containing special characters like underscores
SELECT
  job_code,
  name
FROM
  per_jobs_f_tl
WHERE
  -- Use ESCAPE to search for a literal underscore instead of a wildcard
  job_code LIKE '%\_DIR%' ESCAPE '\'

name: Grand Totals with ROLLUP
code:

  assignment_status_type,
  COUNT(person_id) AS headcount
FROM
  per_all_assignments_m
GROUP BY
  ROLLUP(assignment_status_type)

name: Fetch Visa Details

  person_id,
  visa_permit_type,

FROM
  per_visas_permits_f
WHERE
  TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date

name: Fetch Payment Methods
code:
-- Get personal payment methods (e.g., Direct Deposit, Check)
SELECT
  ppm.assignment_id,
  ppm.percentage,
  ppm.amount,
  opm_tl.org_payment_method_name
FROM
  pay_person_pay_methods_f ppm
  INNER JOIN pay_org_pay_methods_f_tl opm_tl ON ppm.org_payment_method_id = opm_tl.org_payment_method_id
WHERE
  opm_tl.language = 'US'
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN ppm.effective_start_date AND ppm.effective_end_date

name: Fetch Assignment DFF
code:
-- Retrieve Descriptive Flexfields (DFF) attached to an assignment
SELECT
  paam.assignment_id,
  paam.ass_attribute1 AS custom_field_1,
  paam.ass_attribute2 AS custom_field_2
FROM
  per_all_assignments_m paam
WHERE
  TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date

name: Fetch Person EFF
code:
-- Joining to Extensible Flexfields (EFF) tables (Example for PER_PERSON_EIT_EFF)
SELECT
  papf.person_id,
  eff.pei_information1 AS extra_info_1
FROM
  per_all_people_f papf
  LEFT JOIN per_person_eit_eff eff ON papf.person_id = eff.person_id
WHERE
  TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN papf.effective_start_date AND papf.effective_end_date

name: Date Difference in Days
code:
-- Calculate exact number of days between two dates
SELECT
  person_id,
  actual_termination_date,
  date_start,
  -- Subtracting dates in Oracle yields the difference in days
  (actual_termination_date - date_start) AS tenure_in_days
FROM
  per_periods_of_service
WHERE actual_termination_date IS NOT NULL

name: Remove Letters from String (TRANSLATE)
code:
-- Keep only numbers by translating out all alphabet characters
SELECT
  attribute1 AS mixed_string,
  -- TRANSLATE replaces characters one-to-one. Here we replace letters with nothing.
  TRANSLATE(UPPER(attribute1), '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ', '0123456789') AS numbers_only
FROM
  some_custom_table

name: Check for NULL (IS NULL / IS NOT NULL)
code:
-- Standard check to filter out or find missing data
SELECT
  person_id,
  email_address
FROM
  per_email_addresses
WHERE
  email_address IS NOT NULL
  AND person_id IS NULL

name: Fetch Cost Center (GL Default)
code:
-- Retrieve the default Cost Center mapped to an assignment
SELECT
  pac.assignment_id,
  gcc.segment3 AS cost_center -- Adjust segment number based on your Chart of Accounts
FROM
  pay_cost_allocations_f pac
  INNER JOIN gl_code_combinations gcc ON pac.cost_allocation_keyflex_id = gcc.code_combination_id
WHERE
  TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN pac.effective_start_date AND pac.effective_end_date

name: Fetch Worker Type (Employee vs Contingent)
code:
-- Identify if a worker is an Employee (E), Contingent Worker (C), or Non-Worker (N)
SELECT
  person_id,
  worker_type
FROM
  per_periods_of_service
WHERE
  -- Make sure to check the active period of service
  actual_termination_date IS NULL

name: Extract JSON Value (Oracle 12c+)
code:
-- Parse JSON data stored in a CLOB or VARCHAR2 column
SELECT
  -- Assuming 'custom_json_data' is a column containing {"department":"Sales", "id":123}
  JSON_VALUE(custom_json_data, '$.department') AS extracted_dept
FROM
  some_custom_integration_table

name: Fetch Last Update User
code:
-- See who last updated the employee profile record
SELECT
  person_id,
  last_updated_by,
  last_update_date
FROM
  per_all_people_f
WHERE
  TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date
